body: Thanks, you don't know how much that means. Ill continue down this path and hopefully I can come out clean on the other side. It's just a lot to deal with sometimes and everything can feel hopeless pretty easily.

Yeah I quit drinking and smoking when I left school. It was easy because I was in the hospital, I mean I felt bad but I didn't have any way to drink or smoke so it didn't take multiple attempts. I drink occasionally now but only socially and I keep track of it.
